cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry your book bag. I taught you to keep a hand free for tickets; my shoulder can manage one more staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it. There are dictionaries in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Such a considerate offer. You're learning. Keep those tickets ready; I'll change shoulders at the bottom.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our train's moved to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, lead on. You remembered the board. Now find us a seat, like I showed you; these fingers will have earned a very long rest by then.

reason: Replace the abstract other-travel-skill label with a gracious concrete seat-finding request and an explicit description of growing strain.
